headline: AUD is the desk's weak link: buy EURAUD on a dip, sell AUDJPY, and diversify with a USDCAD dip-buy.
market_summary: Risk-off tape: US and European indices broke 20-bar lows with 4H RSI near 17-26 and VIX well above its median, after a weak Philly Fed (6.3 vs 20). USD and JPY are the strongest currencies while AUD is the weakest on every window after a -43.5K jobs miss that cut AUD 2y yields by 21.6 bp on the week. All four lenses agree on AUD weakness; the debate was over how to express it without chasing stretched pairs like AUDUSD (RSI 24.7). Indices are too stretched to short and lack a reversal trigger to buy.

horizon_view.1d: Pullback toward 1.6440 likely after RSI 72 breakout; retest of the 1.6484 week high possible.
horizon_view.3d: Best horizon: Leading/Leading RRG and widening rate spread carry it through 1.6484 toward 1.6560.
horizon_view.5d: Trend extension to ~1.6610 if Mon EUR PMIs and Tue Ifo do not disappoint; AUD CPI Wed is the swing risk.

ideas.thesis: EUR has the strongest 4H momentum and AUD the weakest, and the pair just closed above its 20-bar high with price above SMA20 and SMA200. The 2y spread narrowed 25.9 bp in a week and retail is 70% short, so the move has macro and contrarian support. RSI 72 and weekly VWAP z 2.05 argue for a pullback entry rather than a market buy.
evidence: Tech: bullish engulfing breakout above the 20-bar high, +2.45 ATR over SMA20, MACD above zero
COT: AUD Composite 0 (net -151,753, shorts still building) but EUR also an extreme-bearish flag, so spread only +6
Flow: Leading/Leading RRG on 4H and Daily, crowd 30.03% long with shorts -290 pips, week z 0.85
Macro: EUR 2y +4.3 bp vs AUD 2y -21.6 bp on 1w after AUD jobs miss
risks: Overbought 4H (RSI 72.1) - the limit may not fill
Weak euro-area PMIs/Ifo or a hot AUD CPI

Retail is 70% long and under water, and risk-off hits AUD harder than JPY. Conviction is cut to 3 because Tech flags regular bullish divergences across all JPY crosses.

COT: composite spread -98 (AUD 0 vs JPY 98, both still building)

ideas.thesis: The cleanest non-AUD idea: a clean uptrend stack with hidden bullish divergences and a daily RRG Leading. Retail is only 17.95% long with shorts down 200 pips, the most lopsided crowd on the board. Buy the dip to SMA20 rather than the week high.

COT: USD 78 vs CAD 75, no spread edge

Macro: crude stock build (+3.38M vs -0.48M) mildly CAD-negative; no rate edge

dissent: Technical rejects AUDJPY because every JPY cross carries regular bullish divergences in a liquidation tape, while COT/Flow/Macro see a still-building trend. Two of the three ideas are AUD shorts (EURAUD long, AUDJPY short) - treat them as one AUD theme ahead of Wednesday's AUD CPI.
